 November Social Security direct payment worth up to $994 goes out in 9 days
 By Adisa Hargett-Robinson 
 Published
 October 21, 2026 9:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The November Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994, will be sent to recipients in 9 days.
 SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month. The program supports people with limited income who are blind, age 65 or older, or have a qualifying disability.
